Title: ProdRescue AI: Turn 3 AM Slack chaos into board-ready reports & auto-fixes | Product Hunt
# ProdRescue AI. ## Turn 3 AM Slack chaos into board-ready reports & auto-fixes. ## Turn 3 AM Slack chaos into board-ready reports & auto-fixes. ProdRescue AI reads your war-room threads, correlates logs, and generates a board-ready RCA in 2 minutes. This is the 2nd launch from ProdRescue AI. ## Autonomous Incident Reports & Fixes. ProdRescue AI reads your Slack threads, correlates logs, and generates board-ready RCAs in 2 minutes. What’s new in v2.0: • Autonomous Mode: AI searches your GitHub repo to suggest code fixes. • Evidence Mapping: Every claim is linked to source logs [1]. ProdRescue AI Turn 3 AM messy logs into board-ready incident report in 1m. ### How we handle log privacy and eliminate AI hallucinations in incident reports? As we launch ProdRescue AI today, I wanted to open a dedicated thread for the two most common questions we get from engineering leads: Data Privacy and Accuracy. Our engine is designed to be ephemeral we process logs to generate the report and then they are gone. We don t store your raw logs, and we certainly don t use them to train any AI models. Every claim in a ProdRescue report (like a specific error or a timeline event) includes a direct reference to the exact log line it came from. If the AI can't find the evidence in your logs, it won't put it in the report. No reviews yetBe the first to leave a review for ProdRescue AI. 👋 I'm Devrim, founder of ProdRescue AI. You fix the bug, you’re exhausted, but then you have to spend 4 more hours reconstructing a timeline from 200 chaotic Slack messages and fragmented logs just to please the execs. What’s new in ProdRescue AI:. Autonomous Mode: It doesn't just write the report; it connects to your GitHub repo, searches for the faulty code, and suggests a fix/PR. I’ll be here all day to answer your questions about the AI engine, our security architecture, or how we handle complex Slack threads. I'm Devrim, the solo founder of ProdRescue AI. ProdRescue turns Slack threads, logs, and incident notes into a board-ready postmortem in under 2 minutes.
